Party
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava

For the Petitioner : Mr. Rajesh Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. P.D. Agrawal, Spl.P.P Order
No.05 Dated- 13.06.2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Bagru P.S. Case No. 26 of 2023 (Spl.
Pocso 02 of 2024) registered under sections 363 and 366A of Indian Penal Code, charge has been
framed under section 363, 366A, 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and under section 6 of Pocso
Act, section 3(1)(w)(i) and section 3(1)(w)(ii) and under section 3(2)(v) of Sc/St Act.
3. On 08.10.2023, when the informant found his daughter missing from his house.

After enquiry,
the informant came to know that petitioner has enticed her minor daughter for the purpose of marriage.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case with ulterior motive.
There was love affairs between the parties and due to some differences, the father of the victim lodge this false case.
It is further submitted that the victim girl has gone with the petitioner out of her own sweet will.
The victim girl is major aged about 18 years.

Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the trial of the case and remain physically present on each and every date till the conclusion of the trial and shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidence or influence the witnesses or gain over them.
The petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 30.10.2023 without any rhymes and reasons.
Hence the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.

5. Learned Addl. P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner and submitted that there is direct allegation against the petitioner that petitioner administered some medicine to the victim gilr as a result of which she lost her sense and after 2-3 days she regained her sense, and she found the presence of the present petitioner.
Thereafter, petitioner coaxed her away to Bangalore where he forcibly established physical relationship with her on pretext of marriage.
Hence, the petitioner may not be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the serious and heinous nature of offence alleged to be committed by the petitioner and materials showing involvement of petitioner in commission of forceful physical relationship with the minor victim girl on pretext of marriage, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, the prayer of anticipatory bail of petitioner is rejected.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
